match_start_at.note: Only 2026 has match_start_at (14,740 matches). Of those, 1,962 have any version visible at least 6h before start and 1,492 of those have a surface. A per-match pre-2026 pre-match replay is not reconstructable.

version_visibility: 2016-2025 selected fixture versions, results and stats become visible at the tournament-end boundary. The replay predicts each tournament cohort before applying any result from that edition.

null_surface.note: All 12,403 null-surface latest-version rows are 2026 rows outside the experiment.

duplicate_records.selection: Latest result at the extraction cutoff; latest coherent two-row stat cohort. All variants share the identical selected rows.

identity.note: Stored model player IDs are used consistently for every variant. Identity was not re-resolved point-in-time, so some histories may be split or merged.

odds.note: No valid 2016-2025 match-winner prices; bookmaker-favourite baseline not evaluable.

covid_2020: 4,480 eligible matches in 2020 vs 10,873 in 2019 and 9,632 in 2021.
